note: Role candidates reviewed for issue #30 (Driver, ORM) and issue #23 (MCP). Rendered to studies/roles/ as the review record. The maintainer selected one per role on 2026-10-25; the selected geometry is drawn by scripts/build.py for src/ and dist/, and the registry role mapping is unchanged.

driver-vertical-stack.description: The current ORM layered geometry, unchanged, reassigned to the Driver role: a top plate over two layers stacked top to bottom.

orm-lateral-slabs.description: The cube sliced into three slabs standing side by side along its right axis, each slab keeping its top and right face.

orm-mirrored-rows.description: Two half-stacks split down the center, with three corresponding layers facing each other across the gap.

orm-lateral-plates.description: The Driver stack turned on its side: a front plate on the left face and two bent layers behind it to the right.

mcp-router-hub.description: 3-Way Router: a hub at the cube's center vertex routing one link into each of the three faces.

mcp-router-channels.description: 3-Way Router in negative space: the cube's three seams become channels meeting at a ringed central hub.

decision.scope: Symbol design only; no rights, license or legal status changes.
